newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean companies in $350 mln Chinese pulp JV.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean companies in $350 mln Chinese pulp JV.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Corp said on Monday it and Shinmoorim Paper Co Ltd had agreed to build a $350 million pulp plant in a joint venture with the Forest Industry Group Ltd of China.
A Ssangyong official said the plant, with an annual capacity of 150,000 tonnes, would be built in three to four years in China's Inner Mongolian autonomous district.
The two South Korean companies would have a 50 percent stake in the venture, with China's Forest Industry Group holding the remaining 50 percent.
Most of the pulp produced in the plant would be exported to South Korea, the official said.
He said the plant's capacity would be doubled to 300,000 tonnes a year if the venture proved successful.
